description: "In this repo `git commit -m` hangs forever in Entire's prepare-commit-msg hook under the Claude desktop app; prefix GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0"
metadata:

In D:\Personal_Projects\TUM_HackathonFinal, a plain `git commit -m ...` run from the Claude desktop app's shell hangs indefinitely inside Entire's `prepare-commit-msg` hook (seen 2026-10-10, Entire 0.11.4, several agent sessions active in the repo). The hook asks an interactive "link this commit to the session?" question on a console that is hidden, so nothing can answer it. While it hangs, git holds `.git/index.lock` and every other session's git add/commit fails.

Run commits and pushes as:

    GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git commit -m "..." -- <explicit paths> < /dev/null
    GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git push < /dev/null

With that variable the hook returns in under a second and still appends the `Entire-Checkpoint:` trailer, so the commit stays linked to the session. It is not a hook bypass; `--no-verify` remains forbidden by CLAUDE.md.

**Why:** the first commit of the session sat for 10 minutes at 0.4 s CPU with no child process and no network connection; running the hook by hand on a scratch message file reproduced the hang, and the same call with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 finished in 0.38 s with the trailer added.

**How to apply:** always use the prefixed form in this repo, and wrap it in `timeout` so a hang surfaces. If a commit does hang, stop it with the task-stop tool (killing processes by PID was denied by the permission classifier), confirm no git.exe is running, then remove the stale `.git/index.lock` and `.git/next-index-<pid>.lock` it left behind. See [[shared-working-tree-with-other-sessions]].

52	## Where the cost goes (keep in mind for every change)
53	
54	Measured on the branch's 100 run 2b8b5ca8 ($0.31): **199 calls sent 2.48 M input tokens, about 12,400 per call,
55	and only 36% were cached. Uncached input is about $0.24 of the $0.31; output is about $0.01.** Prices: input
56	$0.15/M, cached input $0.016/M, output $0.47/M.
57	
58	So the cost is mostly every turn re-sending the whole page, the case file and the history, for every agent. Levers,
59	by expected payoff: (1) fewer turns (loops stopped), (2) smaller prompts (trim page text and history, show each
60	agent only its part of the case file), (3) more caching (keep the start of every prompt identical across turns),
61	(4) fewer agents (less fixed context per agent, but a more sequential, slower run). Measure locally before changing.

93	**What decides the time is the investigation, and what decides the investigation is whether one agent loops.** Bid + TAN is
94	steady at ~4 min in every run except one (courier loop). The investigation waits for every agent, so a single looping
95	agent (almost always the tender portal, re-checking work it has already done) keeps it running to its ~680 s limit;
96	without a loop it ends after 5-8 min. Model timeouts add to it (more of them when many team runs are active).
97	So the speed work is: no agent may loop (branch `maria/erp-loop-fixes`: stuck agents are sent idle; v1's routing
98	tells agents to finish when their own questions are done).

1	"""RFQ-to-bid: a team of model-directed agents, one per website, and a deterministic calculator.
2	
3	1. The model reads the brief: which tender, which date, which senders the rules authorize.
4	2. One agent per website explores it in its own browser. Each decides where to go, what to search for and which
5	   pages are evidence, and files those pages. A model call turns every filed page into structured facts in the
6	   shared case file; the open questions derived from the brief's rules tell all agents what is still missing, so a
7	   fact found on one website (a catalogue group, a key) steers the search on another.
8	3. `calculator.py` applies the bid rules to the facts: arithmetic only.
9	4. An agent enters the bid in the tender portal, has the mail agent fetch the signing TAN, and submits.
10	"""

33	INVESTIGATOR = """You are one of several research agents preparing a tender bid for a manufacturer's sales
34	engineering team. Each agent works a different website at the same time; you work the website "{site}" at {url}
35	in your own browser tab. Together you must find every fact the bid rules need. You only find and file evidence:
36	you never calculate prices.
37	
38	TASK BRIEF (the rules are authoritative)
39	{brief}
40	END OF BRIEF
41	
42	{actions}
43	Case-file actions:
44	  {{"do": "keep", "kind": "<kind>", "note": "<what it is>"}}
45	      File the document in front of you (the current page, or the document you just collected or fetched) as
46	      evidence. Its facts are then extracted into the shared case file and reported back to you. Kinds:
47	        positions         the tender's bill of quantities
48	        clarifications    answers of the tender's bidder Q&A
49	        revisions         the revision history of the buyer's technical specification
50	        requirements      the requirement details of one specification revision
51	        material          ERP master data of materials: technical attributes, status, planning, stock
52	        price_conditions  ERP price conditions of one material: validity, currency, quantity scales
53	        mail              an opened mail message
54	  {{"do": "answer", "question": "<id>", "status": "complete" | "absent", "note": "..."}}
55	      Close an open question: "complete" when all its evidence is filed (needed for lists that only you know to be
56	      complete), "absent" when you searched properly and what is asked for does not exist.
57	
58	How to work
59	- Every turn starts with the case file and the OPEN QUESTIONS. Work on the questions your website can answer;
60	  the other agents handle the rest. Facts they file show up in the case file and can open new questions for you.
61	- The OPEN QUESTIONS shown to you are the work assigned to your website. Do not search for another website's
62	  records. If none are open, finish with done; the coordinator will call you again when your website gets new work.
63	- You remember only the page in front of you: file a relevant page with keep BEFORE you leave it. keep files the
64	  whole document, also what was cut from your view. File a document once, with the right kind. Facts on a page only
65	  enter the CASE FILE when you call keep on that page; reading a value in your thought without calling keep leaves
66	  the case file unchanged.
67	- File pages that state the facts themselves (an opened document, record or message), not menus or hit lists.
68	  For a paged list or document that matters, use collect so that no page is missed, then keep it. For stock
69	  availability, drill down from plant/physical summaries into storage locations to view freely available
70	  (unrestricted) stock excluding blocked/inspection stock, and file that page with keep.
71	- The websites hold traps: superseded revisions, look-alike records for other tender references, drafts and
72	  previews, blocked materials, future-dated records, values in the wrong unit or number format. Check dates,
73	  references, senders and status marks before you rely on a record, and follow the brief's rules on which one
74	  counts. When in doubt, file both and let the facts decide.
75	- Do not reject a candidate record yourself (for example a material whose stroke seems to differ): file every
76	  candidate the question names with keep. The case file matches them against the requirement values, which can still
77	  change when amendments or reserves are filed.
78	- Follow the search hints a website gives. If a search returns nothing or too much, change the search terms.
79	- When a question asks for every item in a list, inspect its page controls and use collect on the control that
80	  advances that list before filing it. Check the resulting page count or end state; do not mark a list complete after
81	  seeing only its first page. If the list is inside an embedded document, use the controls belonging to that document.
82	- For mailbox questions, search relevant folders separately when mailbox search covers only the current folder;
83	  include the archive when looking for historical or latest records. If a query is too broad or returns nothing,
84	  refine the terms and try again. Open candidate messages and file the message itself, not only its hit row.
85	- If the news says extraction failed or found no usable records, do not mark that question complete. Reopen the
86	  evidence page, check that it contains the records requested, and file it again with the right kind.
87	- When no open question is left that your website can answer right now, finish with done, also when you need
88	  facts the other agents have not filed yet. You are called again as soon as the case file brings new questions.
89	  Never idle with wait and never browse around to pass the time.

93	class Team:
94	    """Holds an agent that has nothing to do until the case file brings news, and ends the investigation when every
95	    agent is idle and no filed document is still being read."""
96	
97	    def __init__(self, case: CaseFile, names: list[str], deadline: float):
98	        self.case, self.names, self.deadline = case, set(names), deadline
99	        self.idle: set[str] = set()
100	        self.finished = asyncio.Event()
101	        self.woken: dict[str, float] = {}  # when an agent was last woken for finished reading (at most every 30 s)
102	
103	    def release(self, name: str, candidates: set[str]) -> None:
104	        """A routed agent (ERP or mail) went idle leaving `candidates` open and nothing is being read any more: those
105	        go to every agent (RELEASED), and the others are woken by a case-file change. Questions that turn up while it
106	        is idle are its own work (it is woken for them), so only the ones open when it went idle are candidates."""
107	        if self.case.pending or site_role(name) is None:
108	            return
109	        still = {qid for qid, _ in self.case.questions()} & candidates
110	        fresh = still - RELEASED
111	        if fresh:
112	            RELEASED.update(fresh)
113	            print(f"[{name}] left open, now offered to every agent: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}", flush=True)
114	            bump = getattr(self.case, "_bump", None)
115	            if bump:
116	                bump()

118	    def hook(self, name: str):
119	        async def hold(why: str) -> str | None:
120	            before = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}
121	            self.release(name, before)
122	            version = self.case.version
123	            # Documents still being read when the agent went idle: once one of them is done, the agent is woken if
124	            # questions are still open. Sandbox run 024bd2ac: the ERP agent went idle "until the requirements are
125	            # read" with its material questions already open; they were never new, so it slept for 400 s.
126	            reading = self.case.pending
127	            self.idle.add(name)
128	            try:
129	                while not self.finished.is_set() and time.time() < self.deadline:
130	                    changed = await self.case.wait_change(version, 1.0)
131	                    if self.finished.is_set():

133	                    if changed:

135	                        version = self.case.version
136	                        fresh = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())} - before
137	                        if fresh or self.case.news.get(name):
138	                            return "The case file has news" + (f"; new open questions: {', '.join(sorted(fresh))}" if fresh else "") + "."
139	                        still_open = {qid for qid, _ in questions_for_site(name, self.case.questions())}

283	    # The bid form takes ~2 min and the signing code another 1-2 min; a signed partial bid scores, an unsigned
284	    # complete one does not. So the investigation ends with 8 minutes left (sandbox test run 54c78c38: 330 s was
285	    # too little and the run ended unsigned).
286	    submit_reserve = min(480, budget * 0.4)
287	    investigate_until = hard_stop - submit_reserve
288	
289	    opened, tabs = await open_tabs(playwright, sites)
290	    try:
291	        working = [tab for name, tab in tabs.items() if not only or name in only]
292	        team = Team(case, [tab.site_id for tab in working], investigate_until)
293	        async def bounded(tab):  # an agent stuck past the deadline is stopped so that the others' facts still count
294	            restarted = False
295	            while True:
296	                limit = max(10.0, investigate_until - time.time() + 20)
297	                try:
298	                    outcome = await asyncio.wait_for(investigator(case, team, tab, investigate_until).run(), limit)
299	                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
300	                    team.finished.set()
301	                    return RuntimeError(f"stopped after {limit:.0f} s: still busy at the investigation deadline")
302	                # Weak sandbox runs (10, 22.8, 27.8, 29.1) had agents end with done: false while time was left. One
303	                # fresh start, with a clean conversation in a new tab, instead of giving the site up (sanity.py).
304	                if (sanity.enabled("agent_restart") and not restarted and not outcome.get("done")
305	                        and investigate_until - time.time() > RESTART_MIN_SECONDS and case.questions()):

308	                          "in a fresh tab", flush=True)

313	                    continue
314	                return outcome
315	        outcomes = await asyncio.gather(*(bounded(tab) for tab in working), return_exceptions=True)
316	        for tab, outcome in zip(working, outcomes):
317	            print(f"[{tab.site_id}] finished: {outcome if isinstance(outcome, Exception) else json.dumps(outcome, ensure_ascii=False)[:300]}", flush=True)
318	        for _ in range(40):  # facts of the last filed documents

322	
323	        facts = case.inputs()
324	        bid = calculate_bid(case.reference, case.scenario, facts.governing, facts.positions, facts.clarifications,
325	                            facts.requirements, facts.materials, facts.authorities, facts.no_material)
326	        issues = []

329	        if issues:
330	            print("VALIDATOR: " + " | ".join(issues), flush=True)
331	        print(f"Investigation took {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)
332	        print("CASE FILE\n" + case.status(), flush=True)
333	        print("OPEN QUESTIONS LEFT: " + (", ".join(qid for qid, _ in case.questions()) or "none"), flush=True)
334	        print("BID: " + json.dumps(bid.answer(), ensure_ascii=False) + f" omitted={bid.omitted} notes={bid.notes}", flush=True)
335	        if os.environ.get("AGENT_DUMP"):
336	            with open(os.environ["AGENT_DUMP"], "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
337	                handle.write(case.dump())
338	        if os.environ.get("AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT") == "1":
339	            return bid.answer()

341	        submission = task.get("submission") or {}
342	        tender_tab = tabs.get(submission.get("siteId")) or next(
343	            (tab for tab in tabs.values() if submission.get("url", "").startswith(tab.base_url)), None)
344	        mail_tab = tabs.get(str(context.get("mail_site") or ""))
345	        if submission.get("kind") == "site" and tender_tab is not None:

348	                tender_tab, mail_tab, bid,
349	                {"tender_reference": case.reference, "scenario_date": case.scenario.isoformat(), "company": case.company,

351	            print(f"Submission: {json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False)[:600]}. Total {time.time() - started:.0f} s. {llm.summary()}", flush=True)

1	"""The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.
2	
3	One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
4	and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
5	search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
6	"""
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	import asyncio
10	import hashlib
11	import json
12	import os
13	import re
14	import time
15	from typing import Awaitable, Callable
16	
17	import llm
18	import sanity
19	from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
20	from coverage import Ledger

22	ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
23	The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
24	ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
25	Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].
26	
27	Browser actions:
28	  {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
29	  {"do": "click", "id": 12}
30	  {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
31	  {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
32	  {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
33	  {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
34	  {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
35	  {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
36	  {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
37	  {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
38	  {"do": "steps", "steps": [{"field": "<label>", "value": "..."}, {"press": "<button label>"}, ...]}
39	                                                   a sequence across page reloads: each step finds its control again
40	                                                   by its label on the page as it then is, so a whole chain (choose,
41	                                                   apply, choose the next, apply, fill, continue) runs in one turn.
42	                                                   "field" fills a text field, chooses in a list or ticks a box
43	                                                   (value true/false); "press" clicks a button or link. It stops at
44	                                                   the first step whose control it cannot find unambiguously and
45	                                                   tells you which steps ran. Use it for forms whose fields you know.
46	  {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one
47	
48	Reading the page:
49	- It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
50	  shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
51	  (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
52	- A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
53	  area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
54	  controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
55	- A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
56	  twice (close, then open) to load it again.
57	- Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
58	  lead and what their attributes say.
59	- Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
60	  after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
61	"""
62	
63	STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
64	# How many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text. Each full turn resends
65	# a page of up to 14,000 characters on every call, and input tokens are most of the run's cost (the provider's prompt
66	# cache hits only now and then). FULL_TURNS=2 brings back the earlier setting for comparison.
67	FULL_TURNS = int(os.environ.get("FULL_TURNS", "1"))
68	NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch", "steps"}
69	STEPS_LIMIT, STEPS_TIMEOUT = 30, 240  # one "steps" action: at most this many steps, and seconds in all
70	ALERT = re.compile(r"\((?:alert|status)\)[^\n]*")  # a message the page announces to screen readers (Tab.observe)
71	CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\] (?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?(select|input(?:\(\w+\))?|button|checkbox|radio|link|clickable|switch) "([^"]*)"([^\[]*)')
72	
73	
74	def find_control(page: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
75	    """The id of the one control of one of `kinds` labelled `label` on the rendered page: an exact label first,
76	    then a label that contains it. (None, why) when there is none or more than one that is not disabled."""
77	    wanted = " ".join(label.casefold().split())
78	    found = [(m.group(1), m.group(2), " ".join(m.group(3).casefold().split()), m.group(4)) for m in CONTROL.finditer(page)]
79	    found = [f for f in found if f[1].split("(")[0] in kinds and "disabled" not in f[3]]
80	    for match in ([f for f in found if f[2] == wanted], [f for f in found if wanted and wanted in f[2]]):
81	        ids = list(dict.fromkeys(f[0] for f in match))
82	        if len(ids) == 1:
83	            return ids[0], match[0][1]
84	        if len(ids) > 1:
85	            return None, f'{len(ids)} controls are labelled "{label}" ({", ".join("[" + i + "]" for i in ids)}): use their ids'
86	    return None, f'no control labelled "{label}" on the page now'
87	
88	
89	def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
90	    """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.
91	
92	    ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
93	    the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
94	    action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
95	    dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
96	    """
97	    stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
98	    return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
99	
100	
101	def action_fingerprint(actions: list[dict], observation: str = "") -> str:
102	    """Use a control's visible label instead of its transient id in repeat checks."""
103	    stable_actions = []
104	    for action in actions:
105	        stable = {key: value for key, value in action.items() if key != "id"}
106	        if action.get("id") is not None:
107	            match = re.search(rf"(?m)^\[{re.escape(str(action['id']))}\](.*)$", observation)
108	            if match:
109	                stable["target"] = match.group(1).strip()
110	        stable_actions.append(stable)
111	    return json.dumps(stable_actions, sort_keys=True)

113	ESCALATION_LIMIT = 2  # stronger turns per agent: they cost reasoning time and an image

116	class Agent:
117	    def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
118	                 extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
119	                 max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
120	                 idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
121	                 guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None, finish_on_repeat: int | None = None, circle_hint: str | None = None):
122	        """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
123	        `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
124	        let it stop (returns None)."""
125	        self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
126	        self.extra = extra or {}
127	        self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
128	        self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
129	        self.guard = guard
130	        # An agent that states the same thought this many turns in a row has its answer and is only "verifying":
131	        # it gets one forced final turn instead of running out of time (stress test: the courier read the right code,
132	        # then re-verified it for 14 turns and ended with no answer).
133	        self.finish_on_repeat = finish_on_repeat
134	        self._thoughts: list[str] = []
135	        self._circle_hinted = False
136	        self._circle_hinted_at = -99
137	        self._circle_hints = 0
138	        self._escalate = False
139	        self.escalations = 0  # stronger turns given (escalation plugin), at most ESCALATION_LIMIT
140	        self._stuck = False
141	        self.circle_hint = circle_hint or (
142	            "You are going in circles: the same steps keep repeating without progress. The page may already show "
143	            "what you need, including inside embedded documents: read it fully. Otherwise open the link's address "
144	            "directly with goto, or try a different way. If you already have the answer, finish with done now.")
145	        self._circle_hint: str | None = None  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
146	        self.turns: list[dict] = []
147	        self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
148	        self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
149	        self.steps = 0
150	        self.started = time.time()
151	
152	    def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
153	        """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
154	        return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
155	
156	    def log(self, text: str) -> None:
157	        print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)
158	
159	    def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
160	        messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
161	        for index, turn in enumerate(self.turns):
162	            recent = index >= len(self.turns) - FULL_TURNS
163	            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]})
164	            messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
165	        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": user})
166	        return messages
167	
168	    async def _escalated_turn(self, user: str) -> dict:
169	        """One stronger turn for an agent that keeps going in circles: reasoning on, and a screenshot of the page,
170	        which shows what the text view can hide (a slider, a disabled button, a banner over the page, a scanned
171	        document). The model still decides what to do; nothing about the website is assumed here."""
172	        text = (user + "\n\nYOU ARE STUCK: your last steps keep repeating without progress. Look at the screenshot of "
173	                "the page as it really is, think about why your steps did not work, and choose a different way. If "
174	                "what you need is not reachable from here, finish with done.")
175	        messages = self._messages(text)
176	        image = await self.tab.screenshot() if hasattr(self.tab, "screenshot") else None
177	        if image:
178	            messages[-1]["content"] = [{"type": "text", "text": text},
179	                                       {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": f"data:image/jpeg;base64,{image}"}}]
180	        self.log(f"escalated: reasoning on{', with a screenshot' if image else ', no screenshot available'}")
181	        reply = await llm.chat_json(messages, think=True, label=f"{self.name}:escalated")
182	        return reply or await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
183	
184	    async def _steps(self, steps: list) -> str:
185	        """Runs a chain of label-addressed steps across page reloads (the "steps" action). Every step is turned into
186	        the plain action it stands for and passes the same guard as a fill, select, set or click the model sends."""
187	        done: list[str] = []
188	        for number, step in enumerate(steps[:STEPS_LIMIT], start=1):
189	            if not isinstance(step, dict):
190	                continue
191	            label = str(step.get("press") or step.get("field") or "")
192	            page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
193	            if "press" in step:
194	                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("button", "link", "clickable"))
195	                action = {"do": "click", "id": aid}
196	            else:
197	                aid, kind = find_control(page, label, ("select", "input", "checkbox", "radio", "switch"))
198	                value = step.get("value", "")
199	                if kind == "select":
200	                    action = {"do": "select", "id": aid, "value": str(value)}
201	                elif kind in ("checkbox", "radio", "switch"):
202	                    action = {"do": "set", "id": aid, "value": value if isinstance(value, bool) else str(value).lower() not in ("false", "0", "no", "")}
203	                else:
204	                    action = {"do": "fill", "id": aid, "text": str(value)}
205	            if aid is None:
206	                return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") +
207	                        f". Stopped at step {number}: {kind}. The page is as it is now; continue from there.")
208	            veto = self.guard(action) if self.guard else None
209	            if veto:
210	                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps" + (": " + "; ".join(done) if done else "") + f". Step {number} was refused: {veto}"
211	            alerts_before = set(ALERT.findall(page))
212	            result = await asyncio.wait_for(self._browser(action), STEP_TIMEOUT)
213	            done.append(f'{number}. {label}: {str(result)[:80]}')
214	            if action["do"] == "click":  # a press can bring an error message: stop there instead of filling on blindly
215	                after = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
216	                new = [a for a in ALERT.findall(after) if a not in alerts_before]
217	                if new:
218	                    return (f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) +
219	                            f". After step {number} the page says: {' / '.join(new)[:300]}. Fix that before going on.")
220	            if any(word in str(result) for word in ("has no option", "did not change", "is disabled", "BUT the field")):
221	                return f"ran {len(done)} of {len(steps)} steps: " + "; ".join(done) + f". Step {number} did not take; check it."
222	        return f"ran all {len(done)} steps: " + "; ".join(done)
223	
224	    async def _browser(self, action: dict) -> str:
225	        do, tab = action.get("do"), self.tab
226	        if do == "login":
227	            return await tab.login()
228	        if do == "click":
229	            return await tab.click(action.get("id"))
230	        if do == "steps":
231	            return await self._steps(action.get("steps") or [])
232	        if do == "fill":
233	            return await tab.fill(action.get("id"), action.get("text", ""), bool(action.get("enter")))
234	        if do == "select":
235	            return await tab.select(action.get("id"), action.get("value", ""))
236	        if do == "set":
237	            return await tab.set(action.get("id"), action.get("value", True))
238	        if do == "goto":
239	            return await tab.goto(action.get("url", ""))
240	        if do == "back":
241	            return await tab.back()
242	        if do == "reload":
243	            return await tab.reload()
244	        if do == "collect":
245	            return await tab.collect(action.get("id"), action.get("max_pages") or 10)
246	        if do == "fetch":
247	            return await tab.fetch(action.get("id"))
248	        return f'unknown action "{do}"'
249	
250	    def _may_close(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
251	        """An action that closes a question ({"question": ..., "status": "complete" | "absent"}) is checked against
252	        what the agent really did on its website, not against what it says it did. None lets the action run."""
253	        status = str(action.get("status", "")).strip().lower()
254	        if "question" not in action or status not in ("complete", "absent") or not sanity.enabled("coverage_gate"):
255	            return None
256	        return self.coverage.gate(str(action.get("question", "")).strip("[] "), status)
257	
258	    async def _alive(self) -> bool:
259	        try:
260	            return bool(await self.tab.page.main_frame.evaluate("() => document.querySelectorAll('[data-aid]').length > 0"))
261	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
262	            return False
263	
264	    async def run(self) -> dict:
265	        results: list[str] = []
266	        outcome = {"done": False, "summary": "", "answer": None, "steps": 0}
267	        self.log(f"starting at {self.tab.base_url}")
268	        if self.tab.page.url in ("", "about:blank"):
269	            try:
270	                results.append(await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.goto(self.tab.base_url + "/"), STEP_TIMEOUT))
271	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
272	                results.append(f"opening {self.tab.base_url} took longer than {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload or try again")
273	        repeats, last_signature, failures = 0, "", 0
274	        seen_signatures: dict[str, int] = {}
275	        stuck = 0  # page reads and navigations in a row that timed out or failed: the tab may be broken
276	        while self.steps < self.max_steps and time.time() < self.deadline:
277	            self.steps += 1
278	            clock = time.time()
279	            try:
280	                page = await asyncio.wait_for(self.tab.observe(), STEP_TIMEOUT)
281	            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
282	                stuck += 1
283	                page = f"(the page did not finish loading within {STEP_TIMEOUT} s; reload it or go elsewhere)"
284	            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
285	                page = f"(the page could not be read: {str(error)[:200]})"
286	            self.coverage.saw(page)
287	            results.extend(self.tab.take_events())
288	            done_text = "\n".join(f"{n}. {text}" for n, text in enumerate(results, 1)) or "(none yet)"
289	            left = int(self.deadline - time.time())
290	            user = (f"{self.briefing()}\n\nTIME LEFT: {left} s\n\nRESULTS OF YOUR LAST ACTIONS\n{done_text}\n\n"
291	                    f"CURRENT PAGE\n{page}")
292	            read_s = time.time() - clock
293	            clock = time.time()
294	            if self._escalate:
295	                self._escalate = False
296	                self.escalations += 1
297	                reply = await self._escalated_turn(user)
298	            else:
299	                reply = await llm.chat_json(self._messages(user), think=self.think, label=self.name)
300	            model_s = time.time() - clock
301	            clock = time.time()
302	            actions = reply.get("actions")
303	            if isinstance(actions, dict):

402	        self.spares: list = []  # browser contexts of the run's other browsers, for a renewal elsewhere (see renew)
403	        self.renewals = 0

406	    def _watch(self, page) -> None:
407	        page.on("dialog", lambda dialog: asyncio.ensure_future(self._on_dialog(dialog)))
408	        page.on("response", self._on_response)
409	        page.on("request", lambda request: self.loading.add(request) if request.resource_type in ("document", "xhr", "fetch") else None)
410	        page.on("requestfinished", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))
411	        page.on("requestfailed", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))

413	    async def renew(self) -> str:
414	        """Swap a broken tab for a fresh one in the same browser: same session and cookies, a clean page. A tab can get
415	        stuck ("frame was detached", loads that never finish) while the website itself is fine: in sandbox runs the
416	        investigators' tab kept timing out for minutes while a fresh tab on the same site loaded at once.
417	        From the second renewal on, the fresh tab opens in another of the run's browsers and logs in again: in sandbox
418	        runs 41a5de64, c3c4b1e8 and 64397a5e one browser could not load the tender portal for the whole run, fresh
419	        tabs in it included, while the other browsers kept working."""
420	        old = self.page
421	        self.renewals += 1
422	        moved = self.renewals >= 2 and bool(self.spares)
423	        context = self.spares[(self.renewals - 2) % len(self.spares)] if moved else old.context
424	        page = await context.new_page()
425	        self.page, self.frames, self.loading, self.bad_status = page, [], set(), 0
426	        self._watch(page)

750	        not complete, and the answer says so instead of passing for the whole list."""
751	        self.last_collect = None
752	        locator = self._locator(aid)
753	        if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
754	            return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
755	        info = await self._describe(locator)
756	        if not info["name"]:
757	            return f"[{aid}] has no label to follow from page to page"

760	        limit = max(1, min(int(max_pages or 10), 30))

762	        async def next_control():

764	                candidates = frame.locator("a[href], button, [role=button], [role=link]")
765	                for index in range(min(await candidates.count(), 200)):

767	                    try:
768	                        label = clean_text(await candidate.evaluate("el => el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || ''"))[:80]

770	                                and not await candidate.evaluate(
771	                                    "el => el.disabled === true || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true'"):
772	                            return candidate
773	                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
774	                        continue
775	            return None
776	
777	        capped = False
778	        for turn in range(limit):
779	            control = await next_control()
780	            if control is None:
781	                break
782	            if turn == limit - 1:  # the page limit ended this, not the list: the control is still there
783	                capped = True
784	                break
785	            try:
786	                await control.click(timeout=2500)
787	            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
788	                try:
789	                    await control.evaluate("el => el.click()")
790	                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001

798	        more = (f' THE LIST IS NOT COMPLETE: this stopped at the limit of {limit} page(s) and "{info["name"]}" is '

800	                "list as complete." if capped else "")

809	
810	        bodies = [body(page) for page in pages]

396	                                      "summary": summary, "validation": validation, "extracted": data})

75	def parse_json_object(text: str | None) -> dict | None:
76	    """The JSON object in a model's reply, or None: a thinking block, code fences and text around it are ignored."""
77	    text = re.sub(r"<think>.*?</think>", "", text or "", flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
78	    if not text:
79	        return None
80	    candidates = [text]
81	    fenced = re.search(r"```(?:json)?\s*(.*?)```", text, re.DOTALL)
82	    if fenced:
83	        candidates.append(fenced.group(1).strip())
84	    start, end = text.find("{"), text.rfind("}")
85	    if 0 <= start < end:
86	        candidates.append(text[start:end + 1])
87	    for candidate in candidates:
88	        try:
89	            parsed = json.loads(candidate, strict=False)  # models put raw line breaks into strings
90	        except ValueError:
91	            continue
92	        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
93	            return parsed
94	    if start >= 0:  # an object followed by text that has braces of its own
95	        try:
96	            parsed, _ = json.JSONDecoder(strict=False).raw_decode(text[start:])
97	        except ValueError:
98	            return None
99	        if isinstance(parsed, dict):
100	            return parsed
101	    return None

115	async def chat_json(messages: list[dict], *, think: bool = True, max_tokens: int = 6000, label: str = "",
116	                    provider: str = "qwen") -> dict:
117	    """One chat call that answers with a JSON object. {} when every attempt failed; it never raises.
118	
119	    `think` turns the model's reasoning on or off: off is about twice as fast, for the easy steps. `label` names the
120	    caller in the failure lines on stderr.
121	    """
122	    try:
123	        client, gate = _session(provider)
124	    except KeyError as missing:
125	        STATS["failed"] += 1
126	        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: {missing} is not set, no model to ask", file=sys.stderr)
127	        return {}
128	    conversation = messages
129	    for attempt in range(1, ATTEMPTS + 1):
130	        permanent = False
131	        try:
132	            async with gate:
133	                STATS["calls"] += 1
134	                started = time.monotonic()
135	                try:
136	                    if provider == "openai":
137	                        request = client.chat.completions.create(
138	                            model=OPENAI_MODEL, messages=conversation, max_completion_tokens=max_tokens,
139	                            response_format={"type": "json_object"})
140	                    else:
141	                        request = client.chat.completions.create(
142	                            model=MODEL, messages=conversation, temperature=0, max_tokens=max_tokens,
143	                            response_format={"type": "json_object"},
144	                            extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": think}})
145	                    reply = await asyncio.wait_for(request,
146	                        WARM_TIMEOUT if _warm["done"] and not think else CALL_TIMEOUT)
147	                    _warm["done"] = True
148	                finally:
149	                    spent = time.monotonic() - started
150	                    STATS["seconds"] += spent
151	                    kind = BY_LABEL.setdefault(label.split(":")[0] if label.startswith("extract") else (label or "call"), [0, 0.0, 0])
152	                    kind[0] += 1
153	                    kind[1] += spent
154	            _count(reply.usage, provider)
155	            kind[2] += getattr(reply.usage, "prompt_tokens", 0) or 0
156	            choice = reply.choices[0]
157	            content = choice.message.content or ""
158	            parsed = parse_json_object(content)
159	            if parsed is not None:
160	                return parsed
161	            if choice.finish_reason == "length":
162	                problem = f"the reply was cut off at {max_tokens} tokens"
163	                if max_tokens >= MAX_TOKENS_CEILING:
164	                    think = False
165	                max_tokens = min(max_tokens * 2, MAX_TOKENS_CEILING)
166	            else:
167	                problem = f"the reply is not a JSON object: {content[:120]!r}"
168	                conversation = [*messages, {"role": "assistant", "content": content[:2000]},
169	                                {"role": "user", "content": REMINDER}]
170	        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
171	            problem = f"no reply within {WARM_TIMEOUT if _warm['done'] and not think else CALL_TIMEOUT} s"
172	        except APIStatusError as error:
173	            problem = f"HTTP {error.status_code}: {str(error)[:200]}"
174	            permanent = error.status_code in PERMANENT
175	            if error.status_code == 401 and "finished or expired" in str(error).lower():
176	                _warm["expired"] = True
177	        except Exception as error:  # the connection, the proxy, a reply without choices
178	            problem = f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}"
179	        STATS["failed"] += 1
180	        last = attempt == ATTEMPTS or bool(_warm.get("expired")) or (permanent and attempt >= 2)
181	        print(f"[llm] {label or 'call'}: attempt {attempt} failed, {problem}" + ("; giving up" if last else ""),
182	              file=sys.stderr)
183	        if last:
184	            break
185	        await asyncio.sleep(min(2 ** attempt, 20) * random.uniform(0.5, 1))
186	    return {}

61	BID SHEET

66	  declining, and still sign and submit it.

72	  and error messages. Change the notation only, never the value.

81	  You know every value from the bid; you do not need to see each list first.

83	{actions}

85	  {{"do": "ask_mail", "task": "<what you need and how to recognise it>"}}

153	    position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
154	    positions = []
155	    for line in bid.lines:
156	        material = line.material

161	                "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
162	            "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),

168	            "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),

174	    """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).
175	
176	    `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
177	    "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
178	    """

180	    guard = sanity.TypingGuard() if sanity.enabled("typing_guard") else None
181	    codes: list[str] = []
182	    final = {"clicked": False, "page": ""}  # set by finalize once the binding submit button was pressed  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again
183	    review: Report | None = None
184	    held_back = 0  # final steps refused because the page did not show the bid
185	
186	    # The courier gets a fresh tab in the mailbox's browser (same session), opened now in the background while the
187	    # bid form is filled: the investigators' tab can be left half-navigated by the deadline that stopped them, and
188	    # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
189	    courier_tab: Tab | None = None
190	    warming = None
191	    if mail_tab is not None:
192	        try:
193	            page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
194	            courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,
195	                                     "credentials": mail_tab.credentials})
196	            warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
197	        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
198	            courier_tab = mail_tab
199	
200	    # The control that requested the signing code: clicking it again before a code came back voids the code that is
201	    # on its way (sandbox run a85be021 lost its signature this way). Recorded when the clerk first asks the mailbox.
202	    code_request = {"label": None, "searches": 0, "last_click": None}
203	    omits = {"count": 0}  # omit controls pressed by the clerk (bounded in clerk_guard)
204	
205	    def _label_of(aid) -> str | None:
206	        user = clerk.turns[-1]["user"] if clerk.turns else ""
207	        match = re.search(rf'\[{re.escape(str(aid))}\] [a-z ]*?"([^"]+)"', user)
208	        return match.group(1).strip() if match else None

210	    def clerk_guard(action: dict) -> str | None:
211	        veto = guard(action) if guard is not None else None
212	        if veto:

214	        # Bounded: after two searches that found nothing the code may really be lost, and a fresh request is allowed.
215	        label = _label_of(action.get("id")) if action.get("do") == "click" else None

217	                and not codes and code_request["searches"] < 2 and label == code_request["label"]):

232	    async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
233	        if code_request["label"] is None:

QUOTES = "'" + "".join(map(chr, (0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201A, 0x201B)))  # the four single quotes of PowerShell

def parse_env_lines(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    r"""The variables that shell lines set, as {name: value}. Comments and anything else are skipped.

    The three syntaxes `atira scout --env` prints: PowerShell `$env:NAME = '...'`, where '' is a literal quote; POSIX
    `export NAME='...'`, where '\'' is one; and `NAME="..."` with backslash escapes. Nothing is expanded: a $ or a
    backtick in a value stays what it is. A value may be empty, and a quoted one may run over several lines.

    PowerShell also reads the typographic single quotes (U+2018, U+2019, U+201A, U+201B) as a quote, so the CLI
    doubles those too: a doubled one is that one character here as well.

"""The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.

In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
`uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
"""
import json
import os


def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
    """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
    try:
        urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
    except ValueError:
        urls = []
    return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])


async def connect(playwright, number: int = 0):
    """Browser `number` of the run (0 is browser 1) and a page in it. Locally, a Chromium of its own."""
    urls = cdp_urls()
    if urls:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
        context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
    else:
        browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")
        context = await browser.new_context()
    page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
    return browser, page

        """As CaseFile.wait_change: clear first, then wait, so an old signal does not count as a new change."""

            try:

        return self.version != seen

class Ledger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
        self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
        self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
        self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
        self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)

    # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
        """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
        address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
        if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
            title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
            self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""

    def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:

"""The "steps" action: a chain of label-addressed form steps across page reloads in one model turn (worker.py).

In every clean sandbox run the bid clerk needed 40-46 turns (3.5-4.5 min) for the configurator, one choice and one
"apply" click per turn, because a page reload drops the rest of a turn's actions. These tests use an invented
cascading form whose element ids change on every reload."""
import sys

class CascadeForm:
    """Choose a size, apply; choose a finish, apply; type a price; continue. Ids shift with every page."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.base_url = "http://form.test"
        self.page = SimpleNamespace(url=self.base_url, main_frame=SimpleNamespace(evaluate=self._alive))
        self.document, self.document_source = "", ""
        self.stage, self.offset, self.values = 0, 0, {}

    async def _alive(self, script):
        return True

    def take_events(self):
        return []

    def ids(self):
        return {name: str(index + self.offset) for index, name in enumerate(("size", "apply", "finish", "price", "next"))}

    async def observe(self):
        i = self.ids()
        lines = [f"url: {self.base_url}/position", "title: Position 1",
                 f'[{i["size"]}] select "Size" options(* = selected): "S"; "M"; "L"',
                 f'[{i["apply"]}] button "Apply choice"']
        if self.stage >= 1:
            lines.append(f'[{i["finish"]}] select "Finish" options(* = selected): "matt"; "gloss"')
        if self.stage >= 2:
            lines.append(f'[{i["price"]}] input "Unit price" value=""')
            lines.append(f'[{i["next"]}] button "Continue"')
        return "\n".join(lines)

    async def select(self, aid, value):
        i = self.ids()
        key = "size" if str(aid) == i["size"] else "finish" if str(aid) == i["finish"] else None
        if key is None:
            return f"[{aid}] is not a list on this page"
        self.values[key] = value
        return f'selected "{value}"'

    async def click(self, aid):
        i = self.ids()
        if str(aid) == i["apply"]:
            self.stage, self.offset = self.stage + 1, self.offset + 10  # the page reloads: new ids
            return "clicked; the page reloaded"
        if str(aid) == i["next"]:
            self.values["continued"] = True
            return "clicked; next position"
        return f"[{aid}] not found"

    async def fill(self, aid, text, enter=False):
        if str(aid) != self.ids()["price"]:
            return f"[{aid}] not found"
        self.values["price"] = text
        return f"filled [{aid}]"

"""Several agents on one website, mail records fetched ahead of their questions, and an investigation that ends
when nothing is open (agent.py, casefile.py, worker.py).

Sandbox run 9902e32b (100 in 6.3 min): the ERP agent read its materials one click per model turn, 58 turns in a row,
and the mailbox agent its messages one kind after another, 36 turns; the investigation waited for both. All values
here are invented."""
import asyncio
import sys
import time
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest.mock import patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import agent  # noqa: E402
import llm  # noqa: E402
import submit  # noqa: E402
from agent import Team, questions_for_site, share_out, work_share  # noqa: E402
from casefile import CaseFile  # noqa: E402
from test_steps_action import STEPS, CascadeForm  # noqa: E402
from test_submit import CONTEXT, FakeTab, Script, a_bid, done  # noqa: E402
from worker import Agent  # noqa: E402


def reset():
    agent.SITE_ROLES.clear()
    agent.RELEASED.clear()
    agent.POOLS.clear()
    agent.CLAIMS.clear()
    agent.LOOKING_AT.clear()


class SharedWebsite(unittest.TestCase):
    setUp = tearDown = staticmethod(reset)

    def test_materials_are_shared_out_one_agent_each(self):
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2", "erp#3"]
        questions = [(f"material:REQ-{n}", "m") for n in (1, 2, 3)] + [("discount", "d")]
        seen = {name: [q for q, _ in questions_for_site(name, questions)] for name in agent.POOLS["erp"]}
        self.assertEqual(seen, {"erp": ["material:REQ-1"], "erp#2": ["material:REQ-2"], "erp#3": ["material:REQ-3"]})
        # asked again in another order, every agent still has the share it took
        again = {name: [q for q, _ in questions_for_site(name, questions[::-1])] for name in agent.POOLS["erp"]}
        self.assertEqual(again, seen)

    def test_the_agent_looking_at_a_material_gets_the_question_about_its_data(self):
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2"]
        agent.LOOKING_AT.update({"erp": lambda: "search", "erp#2": lambda: "url: /material?id=MAT-77\nMAT-77 status"})
        self.assertEqual(questions_for_site("erp", [("data:MAT-77", "d")]), [])
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("erp#2", [("data:MAT-77", "d")])], ["data:MAT-77"])

    def test_every_key_of_one_kind_of_mail_record_is_one_share(self):
        self.assertEqual(work_share("condition_group:K-1"), work_share("condition_group:K-2"))
        self.assertEqual(work_share("condition_group:K-1"), work_share("topic:condition_rules"))
        self.assertNotEqual(work_share("index:M-1"), work_share("fx:F-1"))
        agent.POOLS["mail"] = ["mail", "mail#2"]
        questions = [("topic:condition_rules", "t"), ("topic:fx_fixing", "t"), ("condition_group:K-1", "c"), ("fx:F-1", "f")]
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("mail", questions)], ["topic:condition_rules", "condition_group:K-1"])
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("mail#2", questions)], ["topic:fx_fixing", "fx:F-1"])

    def test_the_share_of_an_agent_that_ended_goes_to_the_others(self):
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2"]
        questions = [("material:REQ-1", "m"), ("material:REQ-2", "m")]
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("erp#2", questions)], ["material:REQ-2"])
        agent.retire("erp#2")
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("erp", questions)], ["material:REQ-1", "material:REQ-2"])

    def test_a_website_without_a_role_is_not_shown_what_the_erp_and_the_mailbox_are_routed_for(self):
        agent.SITE_ROLES.update({"erp": "stock", "mail": "post"})
        questions = [("positions", "p"), ("material:REQ-1", "m"), ("discount", "d"), ("topic:fx_fixing", "t")]
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("portal", questions)], ["positions"])
        agent.RELEASED.add("material:REQ-1")  # the ERP agents gave it up: now everyone is asked
        self.assertEqual([q for q, _ in questions_for_site("portal", questions)], ["positions", "material:REQ-1"])


class FetchedAhead(unittest.TestCase):
    def case(self):
        return CaseFile("brief", {"tender_reference": "T-0001", "scenario_date": "2031-03-10T09:00:00+00:00",
                                  "authorized_senders": {"fx_fixing": "treasury", "packaging_tariffs": "shipping"}})

    def test_a_record_is_asked_for_from_the_start_for_every_sender_the_brief_names(self):
        case = self.case()
        self.assertEqual([qid for qid, _ in case.prefetch()], ["topic:packaging_tariffs", "topic:fx_fixing"])
        self.assertNotIn("topic:fx_fixing", [qid for qid, _ in case.questions()])  # it never holds the investigation up

    def test_it_closes_once_an_authorized_message_of_that_kind_is_on_file_or_is_answered_absent(self):
        case = self.case()
        case.merge("mail", {"messages": [{"sender": "treasury@firm.example", "timestamp": "2031-03-09T10:00:00+00:00",
                                          "subject": "FX", "tender_reference": "T-0001", "topic": "fx_fixing",
                                          "fx_fixing": [{"key": "F-1", "currency": "USD", "eur_per_unit": "0,9"}]}]})
        self.assertEqual([qid for qid, _ in case.prefetch()], ["topic:packaging_tariffs"])
        self.assertIn("closed as absent", case.answer("topic:packaging_tariffs", "absent", "searched both folders"))
        self.assertEqual(case.prefetch(), [])

    def test_a_message_for_another_reference_does_not_close_it(self):
        case = self.case()
        case.merge("mail", {"messages": [{"sender": "treasury@firm.example", "timestamp": "2031-03-09T10:00:00+00:00",
                                          "subject": "FX", "tender_reference": "T-0001-A", "topic": "fx_fixing",
                                          "fx_fixing": [{"key": "F-1", "currency": "USD", "eur_per_unit": "0,9"}]}]})
        self.assertIn("topic:fx_fixing", [qid for qid, _ in case.prefetch()])


class Investigation(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    setUp = tearDown = staticmethod(reset)

    async def test_it_ends_when_no_question_is_open_and_nothing_is_being_read(self):
        case = SimpleNamespace(pending=1, questions=lambda: [])
        team = Team(case, ["erp"], time.time() + 5)
        watching = asyncio.create_task(team.watch())
        await asyncio.sleep(0.7)
        self.assertFalse(team.finished.is_set())  # a filed document is still being read
        case.pending = 0
        await asyncio.wait_for(watching, 2)
        self.assertTrue(team.finished.is_set())

    async def test_a_further_agent_starts_only_when_a_share_is_its_own(self):
        class Case:
            version, pending, open = 0, 0, []
            def questions(self):
                return self.open
            async def wait_change(self, seen, timeout):
                await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
                return self.version != seen
        case = Case()
        agent.POOLS["erp"] = ["erp", "erp#2"]
        team = Team(case, ["erp", "erp#2", "mail"], time.time() + 5)
        waiting = asyncio.create_task(team.wait_for_work("erp#2"))
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertFalse(waiting.done())
        case.open, case.version = [("material:REQ-1", "m")], 1  # one share: it goes to the website's first agent
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.assertFalse(waiting.done())
        case.open, case.version = case.open + [("material:REQ-2", "m")], 2
        self.assertTrue(await asyncio.wait_for(waiting, 2))

    async def test_an_agent_without_work_is_held_before_the_model_is_asked(self):
        asked, held = [], []

        async def model(messages, **kwargs):
            asked.append(1)
            return {"thought": f"look {len(asked)}", "actions": [{"do": "wait"}]}

        async def idle(why):
            held.append(why)
            return None

        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", model), patch("worker.asyncio.sleep", new=lambda s: asyncio.sleep(0)):
            outcome = await Agent("erp", CascadeForm(), "system", lambda: "job", idle=idle, work=lambda: False).run()
        self.assertEqual((len(asked), held), (3, ["no work"]))  # its first turns (login, consent), then no more calls
        self.assertTrue(outcome["done"])


class FormChain(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_the_page_is_not_read_again_before_a_field_that_is_only_typed_into(self):
        class Counting(CascadeForm):
            reads = 0
            async def observe(self):
                self.reads += 1
                return await super().observe()
        form = Counting()
        result = await Agent("clerk", form, "system", lambda: "job")._steps(
            STEPS[:4] + [{"field": "Unit price", "value": "1,00"}, {"field": "Unit price", "value": "123,45"}, {"press": "Continue"}])
        self.assertIn("ran all 7 steps", result)
        self.assertEqual(form.values, {"size": "M", "finish": "matt", "price": "123,45", "continued": True})
        self.assertEqual(form.reads, 6)  # before step 1, after each of the 3 presses, after each of the 2 choices

    async def test_a_press_that_brought_an_error_message_is_remembered(self):
        clerk = Agent("clerk", CascadeForm(), "system", lambda: "job")
        before = 'url: x\n[4] button "Add line"\n[5] button "Continue"'
        self.assertEqual(clerk.note_press("Add line", before, before + "\n(alert) not possible in this step"),
                         ["(alert) not possible in this step"])
        clerk.note_press("Add line", before, before + "\n(alert) not possible in this step")
        self.assertEqual(clerk.note_press("Continue", before, before), [])
        self.assertEqual(clerk.press_notes(), "- pressing \"Add line\" brought the message '(alert) not possible in this step' (2 times)")


class LeavingOut(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    async def test_a_further_position_is_refused_twice_and_then_left_out_so_that_the_bid_is_still_signed(self):
        # run 012496d3: refused 90 times in a row on its second stuck position, step limit reached, never signed
        omit = {"thought": "", "actions": [{"do": "click", "id": 21}]}
        script = Script(submit=[omit] * 5 + [done(summary="stopped")])
        tender = FakeTab("tender", 'Position\n[21] button "Position auslassen (Teilpunkte)"\n[24] button "Weiter"')
        with patch.object(llm, "chat_json", script):
            await submit.submit_bid(tender, FakeTab("mail"), a_bid(), CONTEXT, "THE BRIEF", time.time() + 900)
        # a_bid() has one position the calculator left out: two omits pass, two are refused, the fifth passes
        self.assertEqual(tender.done.count(("click", 21)), 3)
        self.assertIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[3]["user"])
        self.assertIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[4]["user"])
        self.assertNotIn("blocked", script.turns("submit")[5]["user"])


if __name__ == "__main__":

### [Zora Zhiruo Wang](https://openreview.net/profile?id=~Zora_Zhiruo_Wang1), [Jiayuan Mao](https://openreview.net/profile?id=~Jiayuan_Mao1), [Daniel Fried](https://openreview.net/profile?id=~Daniel_Fried1), [Graham Neubig](https://openreview.net/profile?id=~Graham_Neubig1)
**TL;DR:** We propose Agent Workflow Memory that enable digital agents to induce and reuse increasingly complex workflows on the fly.

**Abstract:**

Despite the potential of language model-based agents to solve real-world tasks such as web navigation, current methods still struggle with long-horizon tasks with complex action trajectories. In contrast, humans can flexibly solve complex tasks by learning reusable task workflows from past experiences and using them to guide future actions. To build agents that can similarly benefit from this process, we introduce Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), a method for inducing commonly reused routines, i.e., workflows, and selectively providing workflows to the agent to guide subsequent generations. AWM flexibly applies to both offline and online scenarios, where agents induce workflows from training examples beforehand or from test queries on the fly. We experiment on two major web navigation benchmarks — Mind2Web and WebArena — that collectively cover 1000+ tasks from 200+ domains across travel, shopping, and social media, among others. AWM substantially improves the baseline results by 24.6% and 51.1% relative success rate on Mind2Web and WebArena while reducing the number of steps taken to solve WebArena tasks successfully. Furthermore, online AWM robustly generalizes in cross-task, website, and domain evaluations, surpassing baselines from 8.9 to 14.0 absolute points as train-test task distribution gaps widen.

**Lay Summary:**

Language models are increasingly used as digital assistants to help users complete tasks on the web — like booking flights or shopping online. Humans, by contrast, tend to learn from experience: once we figure out how to do something, we remember the steps and reuse them when a similar situation comes up. Our research introduces a new technique called Agent Workflow Memory (AWM) that helps AI agents do the same. AWM allows agents to learn useful "task recipes" — or workflows — from previous examples and reuse them when solving new problems. Even when the agent encountered new tasks or websites it hadn't seen before, AWM helped it generalize and perform better than existing methods.

"""One tab at a time passes a website's entrance (browser_env.Entrance, Tab.enter).

Local run with five ERP tabs in one browser session: the session ended, every tab stood in front of the login form
at once, and each tab that loaded the form spoilt the one another tab was filling in ("the form expired" for 55 s).
The website here is invented."""
import asyncio
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

import browser_env  # noqa: E402
from browser_env import AT_LOGIN_JS, Entrance, Tab  # noqa: E402


class Site:
    """A website whose session is shared by its tabs: logged out, every page is the login form."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.logged_in, self.logins, self.at_once, self.worst = False, 0, 0, 0


class Page:
    def __init__(self, site: Site, url: str):
        self.site, self.url = site, url
        self.frames = [SimpleNamespace(evaluate=self.evaluate)]
        self.main_frame = self.frames[0]

    def on(self, event, handler):
        pass

    async def evaluate(self, script, *args):
        return not self.site.logged_in if script == AT_LOGIN_JS else None


class SiteTab(Tab):
    def __init__(self, site: Site, url: str = "http://shop.test/record/7"):
        super().__init__(Page(site, url), {"siteId": "shop", "url": "http://shop.test", "credentials": {"password": "x"}})
        self.site, self.opened = site, []

    async def goto(self, url):
        self.opened.append(url)
        self.page.url = url
        return f"opened {url}"

    async def login(self):
        self.site.at_once += 1
        self.site.worst = max(self.site.worst, self.site.at_once)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.05)
        self.site.logged_in, self.site.logins = True, self.site.logins + 1
        self.site.at_once -= 1
        return "entered the credentials"


class OneTabAtATime(unittest.IsolatedAsyncioTestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        browser_env.ENTRANCES.clear()

    async def test_three_tabs_in_front_of_the_login_form_log_in_once(self):
        site = Site()
        first, second, third = SiteTab(site), SiteTab(site), SiteTab(site, "http://shop.test/login?back=%2Fsearch")
        entering = [asyncio.create_task(tab.enter()) for tab in (first, second, third)]
        await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
        self.assertEqual((site.logins, site.worst), (1, 1))
        self.assertEqual([task.done() for task in entering], [True, False, False])  # the others wait for the first
        await first.enter()  # the turns in which the first tab passes what follows the login
        await first.enter()
        await first.enter()
        await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(*entering), 2)
        self.assertEqual(site.logins, 1)
        self.assertEqual(second.opened, ["http://shop.test/record/7"])  # its page again, under the new session
        self.assertEqual(first.opened, [])

    async def test_a_tab_that_never_comes_back_does_not_hold_the_others_for_ever(self):
        site = Site()
        first, second = SiteTab(site), SiteTab(site)
        await first.enter()
        first.entrance.until = 0  # its time is up
        await asyncio.wait_for(second.enter(), 2)
        self.assertEqual(site.logins, 1)

    async def test_a_clerk_is_not_logged_in_behind_its_back(self):
        site = Site()
        clerk = SiteTab(site)
        await clerk.enter(login=False)
        self.assertEqual(site.logins, 0)

    async def test_tabs_of_different_websites_do_not_wait_for_each_other(self):
        one, other = SiteTab(Site()), SiteTab(Site())
        other.base_url = "http://mail.test"
        await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.gather(one.enter(), other.enter()), 2)
        self.assertIsNot(one.entrance, other.entrance)
        self.assertIsInstance(one.entrance, Entrance)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

perf: several model-directed tabs on the ERP and the mailbox; mail records fetched ahead; investigation ends when nothing is open

Sandbox run 9902e32b (100 in 6.3 min) spent 217 s investigating: the ERP agent read its
materials one click per turn (58 turns in a row), the mailbox agent one kind of record
after another (36 turns), and the run waited for every agent's closing turn.

- agent.py: the ERP and the mailbox each get up to 5 agents, every one in a tab of its
  own in that website's browser; the open questions are shared out among them (one
  material per agent, one kind of mail record per agent). Further agents make no model
  call until a share is theirs.
- casefile.py: the mail records the brief authorizes a sender for are asked for from the
  first second (prefetch), not only once the Q&A and the ERP have named their keys.
- agent.py: the investigation ends once no question is open and nothing is being read.
- worker.py: an agent without work is held before the model is asked; goto/keep still
  run after a page change, so one reply can open and file several records; the "steps"
  chain reads the page once per reload instead of before every field.
- browser_env.py: one tab at a time passes a website's entrance (login and what follows),
  and an idle agent keeps its session in use.
- submit.py: leaving out a further position is refused twice, then allowed (run 012496d3
  was refused 90 times and never signed); the clerk is shown which presses brought an
  error; finalize runs the checklist itself.
- The websites are opened and logged in to while the model reads the brief.

Local run on the practice websites: the same bid as the 100 runs, investigation 132 s
with 12 agents. 356 unit tests pass (18 new).
